hook:
Scan the I2C bus.
Three chips answer.
kicker: Arduino Uno + OLED, RTC and EEPROM
igCaption: An Arduino Uno scans every I2C address from 1 to 127 and prints the ones that answer. On this canvas the SSD1306 OLED replies at 0x3C, the 24C01 EEPROM at 0x50 and the DS1307 RTC at 0x68. The sketch rescans every 10 seconds, so the serial log keeps updating. Built in Velxio, a free circuit simulator that runs in the browser.
ytTitle: Arduino I2C scanner finds 3 devices on the bus #shorts
ytDescription: The Arduino Uno scans all 127 I2C addresses and reports the SSD1306 OLED at 0x3C, the 24C01 EEPROM at 0x50 and the DS1307 RTC at 0x68. The serial monitor shows each device found and rescans every 10 seconds. Open it in your browser: https://velxio.dev/example/i2c-scanner
